Product Features

  • Stylish TV Stand: Our high-gloss TV stand with a combination of bright white and black adds a touch of elegance to your living room. Color block design in high-gloss white and black. The modern design fits perfectly into any furnishing style.
  • Spacious Storage: Our TV cabinet has four doors, two drawers and three compartments, providing ample space for your multimedia devices, DVDs, games, etc. Everything is neatly stowed away and ready for use.
  • Multi-color LED lighting: LED lighting creates a pleasant atmosphere in your living room. Controllable via app, choose from different colors and customize the lighting to your liking.
  • The installation of the TV cabinet is simple and uncomplicated. You will receive detailed instructions and necessary assembly accessories so that you can set up your cabinets quickly and easily. Add a touch of style to your living room with our high-quality TV cabinets.
  • Please note that there is a high-gloss protective film on the surface of the product.
